provenance.notes: Zone I (R5-09.S3): the two 18x18 frames of the mine's blink loop are the top-row cells 1 and 3 (eye dark, eye bright) of the owner-picked DEPTH MINE animation sheet (six states in two rows of three: dark, dim, bright, dim, severed-chain drift, burst ring), cropped from the committed frames winner with a 6-px key border around each subject box; the pair was probed at equal 273x360 / 274x360 silhouettes and a 14.2-17.5% pixel change between neighbours (a real state change, not a copy). The dark-to-bright pick gives the 2-frame/20-tick pulse its maximum contrast; the dim cell, the severed-drift and the burst-ring cells stay unused until an animation rework names them. The spike field and chain sit on the black-teal deep-water hull per the design; the manifest label reads ZONE I (abyssal-throne sheet), matching the only content that consumes this sprite (content/enemies/zone-i.enemies.json). The design carries its own 1-px near-black navy outline, so the outline pass is off.
